ios.desc:
Stop scrolling. Start searching.

Momento lets you search your photo library using natural language. Just describe the photo you’re looking for, and Momento finds it instantly.
No tags. No albums. No cloud. 
Your photos never leave your device.

► Search photos like you talk:
Type what you remember:
 • “sunset at the beach with my dog”
 • “birthday party with cake”
 • “kids playing in the snow”

Momento understands objects, scenes, activities, colors, and context — even if you never tagged the photo.

► Powered by on-device AI
Momento uses advanced neural networks running entirely on your iPhone.

Photos and search queries are analyzed locally and matched by semantic meaning and not by filenames or metadata.
 • No servers
 • No uploads
 • No tracking

► 100% private by design
 • All processing happens on your device
 • Works fully offline
 • No account required
 • No data collection
 • Your photos stay yours

► Free & Pro
Free
 • Natural language photo search
 • Fully private & offline
 • Search photos from the last 12 months

Pro
 • Search your entire photo library
 • Unlock all AI models
 • Subscription or lifetime option

Rediscover your memories - instantly.
Momento helps you find the moments that matter, without compromising your privacy.

Privacy Policy: https://momento-search.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

show_hn.title: Show HN: On-device natural language search for your iPhone photos

quotes.text:
Hey HN,

I built Momento, an iOS app that lets you search your photo library using natural language.

I started working on this because I was frustrated with Apple Photos search (especially when I did not remember when or where I made the photo) and it often took a lot of time to find a specific old photo.

Momento performs a one-time local index of your photo library and then lets you search using queries like “woman with red hair and a dog by the river”. It returns matching photos from your library.

All processing happens on-device using Core ML. Photos aren’t uploaded anywhere, and search works offline. It's Apple-only for now.

I initially built this for myself, showed it to a few friends, and after getting feedback decided to polish it and release it publicly.

The app is freemium, free to use for the most recent year of photos with the fastest model and a paid unlock for the whole library and more accurate models.

As this is the first public version I'd love to have feedback on UI/UX as well as search quality and your overall opinion on this.

Thank you,
Felix
